privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At YOD Elazig, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data when you use this website.

sections.title: 1) Information We Collect
points: Information you provide directly, such as name, email, phone number, and form submissions.
Technical data collected automatically, such as browser type, IP address, visited pages, and visit time.

sections.title: 2) How We Use Information
points: To provide services and respond to your requests.
To improve user experience and website content.
For security, abuse prevention, and fraud detection.

sections.title: 3) Data Sharing
points: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
We may share data only when necessary for operations, with trusted providers, or when legally required.

sections.title: 4) Data Security and Retention
points: We apply appropriate technical and organizational safeguards.
We keep data only for as long as necessary for stated purposes or legal obligations.

sections.title: 5) Your Rights
points: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data as applicable by law.
You can contact us through the contact page for any privacy-related request.

sections.title: 6) Policy Updates
points: We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be published on this page.

sections.title: 4) Limitation of Liability

We are not liable for indirect damages resulting from website use.
